action: Emerges from the lean-to into humid morning heat and walks toward the Cayenne when he hears Wesley's distressed voice.
thought: Panic costs water. Now we adapt.

action: Crouches by the Cayenne's cracked radiator, seeing the pooled coolant and engine oil, and realizes the water jug sits in the contamination.
thought: Just wasted our water on day one.

action: Sits on the Cayenne's roof, tail curled, watching the two humans move below with cool feline assessment.
thought: They worry over water. I hunt.

description: At the Cayenne's hood, Wesley explains the cracked radiator and fouled water as Chills arrives to assess the damage.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The radiator's cracked. Oil everywhere. I knocked the water in—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Into the pooled oil?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah. I was checking the crankshaft, I—I wasn't thinking—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Okay. We gather from the river. Fresh water. You come.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I fouled our water on day one. This is bad.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Which is why we filter and boil. This teaches us both.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Not what I wanted to learn.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Come on. Let's move.

action: Knelt at the dead campfire, running his hands over the sodden wood and looking toward the river, jaw set.
thought: Get the fire going. He'll steady down.

action: Stood a few meters away, dusty and sweating, watching Chills assess the dead fire and wanting to ask something but not knowing what.
thought: I ruined the water. I ruined everything already.

action: Padded to a shaded spot near the Cayenne's rear and lay down, tail curled, watching the two men with steady green eyes.
thought: Dry place. They'll sort it out eventually.

description: At the dead campfire, Chills assesses what's needed while Wesley watches, guilty and uncertain.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Water's the first thing. Then fire.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The radiator fouled everything. I panicked like an idiot.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're here. You're learning. That's all that matters now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I shouldn't have wasted clean water in the first hour.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: River's maybe two hundred meters. We boil what we need.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How? Everything's soaked. What do I actually do?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Come. Help me get dry wood from the lean-to. We build from there.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay. Show me.

action: Searching under ferns and fallen wood for heartwood, gathering the driest pieces methodically and moving toward the cold fire pit.
thought: The hearts stay dry if you know where to look. We'll eat warm tonight.

action: Slumped on a log near the dead fire, watching Chills work, legs aching and chest tight with the weight of having failed.
thought: I couldn't even keep a fire alive. He should be furious.

action: Prowling the darkening camp edge in that alert, deliberate way cats hunt at dusk, then returning to settle on the Cayenne hood, watching Chills work.
thought: He's focused. The dark won't take us tonight.

description: At the cold fire pit in the fading dusk, Chills gathers heartwood while Wesley sits nearby, defeated. The cat watches from the Cayenne hood as the light fades.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I couldn't restart it. The wood's too wet.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The surface is. The hearts stay dry underneath — come see.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I tried twice. I'm just going to fail again.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You tried. That's not failure yet. Show me where you gathered from.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Why aren't you angry with me?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Day one, Wesley. You're alive. You asked for help. That's enough.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That doesn't feel like enough.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Not yet. But it will be.

action: Kneels at the fire pit, arranging dry heartwood with steady hands and patient breath until a spark catches and blooms into flame.
thought: This will hold. We'll warm tonight.

action: Huddles near the pit, shivering, watching Chills with fear and shame and desperate hope.
thought: Let this work. Please let him be right.

action: Sits on the Cayenne hood, eyes fixed on Chills, tail curled, watching the warmth come.
thought: Fire means safe. Fire means Chills is steady.

description: At the fire pit in full dark, Chills arranges dry heartwood while Wesley huddles nearby, cold and ashamed, with Mutu watching from the Cayenne hood.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'll ruin this too. Like the water.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. This wood is dry. Watch it work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How can you be sure?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Because I've done this a hundred times.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I've done nothing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're learning. That's the only way.

action: He tends the fire in the early light, watching the day break, then looks toward Wesley approaching the campfire.
thought: He's steadier today. Ready for real work.

action: He emerges from the Cayenne shelter, stiff and uncertain, then walks toward Chills at the fire.
thought: I need to do something right today.

action: The cat stretches on the Cayenne hood, ears alert, watching Chills and Wesley at the fire below.
thought: They're moving. Something's lighter today.

description: At the campfire in the early morning light, Wesley approaches Chills and for the first time offers to work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I want to help fix the Cayenne.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Let's go. Battery first.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I don't know engines.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You know how to think. Start there.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Really?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah.

action: He steadies the alternator connector while Wesley works the bolts, watching his focus build with quiet approval.
thought: He's finally stepping up. Really stepping up.

action: He kneels in the mud beneath the Cayenne's open hood, carefully working each bolt free under Chills' patient direction, trying not to overthink every movement.
thought: Slow. Careful. I can actually do this.

action: From a low perch on the roof, the cat watches the two men bent over the engine bay, ears swiveling to track the sounds of work.
thought: They're quiet together. Both steady now.

description: At the bogged Cayenne's engine bay in the midday glare, Chills guides Wesley through salvaging usable parts—the first real work Wesley has done without flinching.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What are we actually looking for?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Battery, wiring, alternator. Everything we strip stays useful.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: But... we need water, food. Does this even matter?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Right now, no. Later, yes. You learn to keep your options open.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay. What do I do?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: These bolts. Slow, don't strip them. I'll steady the connector.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Like this?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Exactly like that.

action: He secures the lean-to's corner ties with practiced knots, then heads toward the fire where Wesley is sitting, the engine parts they salvaged scattered nearby.
thought: He's not running anymore. That's real.

action: He sits heavily by the fire, flexing his torn and blistered palms, watching the raw meat Mutu brought cool on a leaf.
thought: Hands torn up but I made it through.

action: He settles against Chills on the log, tail curled, ears tracking the forest's evening shift as darkness gathers in the canopy.
thought: They're steady now. Both of them.

description: As the light fades at their campfire, Mutu's fresh kill lies on a leaf between them while Wesley flexes his raw hands and Chills tends the flames—a day's work that neither expected Wesley to finish.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's the second time this week he's brought something. How does he know?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: He knows. Always has. Eat—it's fresh.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Raw? I thought we boiled everything.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Your hands couldn't handle the fire anyway. This is safe.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah. Fair. I'm starving and I'm... sore everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You worked hard. Tomorrow will be worse before it gets better.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I don't care. I made it through the day. I didn't panic.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. You just worked. That's everything.

action: He tends the fire and watches Wesley flex his torn hands, the first real calm night in the camp.
thought: He stepped up. He's stronger than I knew.

action: He rests by the fire, examining his shredded hands while Mutu leans against his leg for the first time.
thought: Hands torn but I finished the day.

action: He presses his entire body against Wesley's leg, purring softly, a rare gesture of acceptance after a day of watching him work.
thought: He belongs here now. He's safe.

description: At the fire's edge, Wesley rests his shredded hands while Mutu—for the first time—presses hard against him, and Chills watches a city scholar becoming a survivor.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Hands are absolutely destroyed.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Let me wrap them.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Why waste the medicine on this?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Because you stayed.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: He's leaning on me. Mutu never does that.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: He knows.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Knows what?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That you didn't run.

action: Wakes before first light and stirs the fire into steadier flames, moving with easy purpose.
thought: Today teaches patience, not speed.

action: Emerges from the Cayenne and unwraps his torn hands, flexing them with a sharp wince.
thought: Shredded and swollen. What can I do today?

action: Follows Wesley from the Cayenne and settles against his leg at the fire's warmth.
thought: Safe when I'm close to him.

description: At the fire's edge in the grey dawn, Wesley flexes his shredded hands while Chills tends the embers, and Mutu presses against Wesley's leg—a moment of pause before the day moves forward.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My hands are shredded. I can't do much today.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's yesterday talking. You did good work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: But we're out of food. We need to move.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We do. But slow. The jungle rewards patience, not panic.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's philosophy, not a plan.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Sometimes that's all we've got out here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So what do I do?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Rest this morning. Walk the forest edge this afternoon—light work, eyes and ears.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And if we come up short on food?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We won't. Trust the jungle.

action: Wesley sits at the river's edge, flexing his bandaged hands and watching the water for any movement he could help with.
thought: Stillness is how the jungle works.

action: Chills kneels in the shallows, laying a thin fishing line across a pool with patient, practiced movements.
thought: This is the real teaching right now.

action: Mutu emerges from the forest edge with a small sparrow dangling from its mouth, wet and limp.
thought: He trusts me more each day.

description: Mutu returns with a sparrow as Wesley rests his raw hands at the river's edge and Chills sets a fishing line in the shallows, the three finally moving together at the jungle's pace.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My hands are useless. What am I supposed to do?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Rest. Let them heal. We're not in a race.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We have no food stored. That feels like a race.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Which is exactly why we don't burn out chasing it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I don't follow that logic at all.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You will. Give it time.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: ...Mutu?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That cat doesn't panic. Neither should you.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay. Message received.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Rest now. You're still learning.

action: Setting a fishing line in the shallows with practiced, deliberate movements, unbothered by the hunger.
thought: Let the river give. Don't force it.

action: Sitting on a river rock with his swollen hands resting in his lap, watching Chills work with an edge of frustration.
thought: I should be doing this, not sitting here.

action: Pressing against Wesley's leg, purring steadily and watching the water with amber eyes.
thought: He's hurting. I'll stay close.

description: At the shallows in the hot afternoon, Chills works a fishing line with patient precision while Wesley sits nearby with his raw, swollen hands resting; Mutu presses against Wesley's leg, steady.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How long until these are usable again?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: A couple days if you let them rest.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We have no food. I should be helping.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You are helping. Healing is work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's not how rationing works.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It is. The jungle teaches you to pace yourself.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And if the river doesn't give?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we forage. We adapt. We don't panic.

action: Feeds dry heartwood to the fire, keeping it steady as the dusk darkens around the clearing.
thought: Keep the rhythm. Let him rest now.

action: Sits at the fire's edge with his raw hands resting limp on his thighs, watching Chills work.
thought: My hands are broken. What about tomorrow?

action: Presses against Wesley's leg and watches the fire with steady golden eyes, purring quietly.
thought: He's hurting. I'll stay close.

description: At the fire's edge as dusk thickens, Wesley's hands hang useless while Chills feeds the fire and Mutu presses against Wesley's leg—a quiet collapse and acceptance.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My hands are finished. I can't work tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then you rest. You did good work today.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So I'm useless now.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're tired, not useless. There's a difference.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I wanted to do more.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You will. Tomorrow your hands heal, next day they work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How are you always so calm?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: One day at a time. That's all we have.

action: Tends the smoked fish at the fire's edge, glancing over at Wesley's swollen hands resting on his lap, then back to the flames.
thought: He's learning what really matters now.

action: Sits with his raw, swollen hands elevated across his knees, wincing at the pain as heat and adrenaline wear off, watching Chills work the fire.
thought: Can't work tomorrow. Can't do anything.

action: Presses against Wesley's leg at the fire, kneading gently and purring, as if anchoring him to something steady.
thought: He hurts but I'm staying close.

description: Wesley finally stops fighting his limits—swollen hands elevated at the fire while Chills tends the fish and Mutu anchors him close as night settles dark around them.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My hands are finished. Can't work tomorrow at all.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: They will heal. Fire, rest, clean water—that's the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: But there's the shelter, the wood, the—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: They'll wait. Your hands matter more than any of that.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So I'm useless to you now.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Resting is work. The real work, right now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I hate this. Needing help.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's not weakness. That's survival.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: At least he believes in me.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So do I.

action: Chills rises early and tends the fire, then walks the perimeter checking the wood pile and assessing what needs doing today.
thought: Wood's running thin. Need to focus.

action: Wesley wakes slowly and inches toward the fire, carefully testing his swollen hands, wincing at the tightness.
thought: Still can't grip anything. Useless.

action: Mutu drops a small lizard at the camp edge and slinks up to the Cayenne hood to rest—morning's work done.
thought: Good hunt, rest now.

description: Wesley tests his swollen hands at the fire while Chills checks the depleted wood pile; Mutu has left a small lizard at the camp edge, a quiet scout's gift before harder work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Morning. How bad are they?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Still swollen. Another day healing.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So what do I do today?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Rest. Help where you can without using your hands.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Look what Mutu brought us.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. She's earning her keep.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: At least one of us is doing something.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You are. Just differently. We'll manage.

action: Chills makes two trips to the river bend to gather the deadwood Mutu found, stacking each armload by the fire with practiced efficiency.
thought: Wood's still not enough, but it buys time.

action: Wesley sits by the fire with his swollen hands resting in his lap, tending the small lizard Mutu brought until it's cooked through.
thought: Keep the fire steady. That's enough.

action: Mutu prowls the camp edges in the heat, then presses close to Chills' leg as he stacks the gathered wood, purring softly.
thought: He's working hard. I'm staying close.

description: By the fire at midday, Chills counts the gathered wood while Wesley wrestles with the weight of rest—whether it truly counts as work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How much did you get?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Three armloads. Mutu found a solid deadfall.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's not much.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. But it's what we've got.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I should be helping. These hands—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Your hands are healing. This is your work.

dialogue.speaker: mutu
dialogue.line: Presses against Chills' leg, purring softly.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Even Mutu knows. Stay close, keep the fire. That's the job.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay.

action: Gathering dry wood from the forest edge, moving steady between dark trunks and camp fire, hands sure and practiced with each piece selected and carried back.
thought: He's learning to be still now.

action: Resting on his back near the fire, palms up on a broad leaf, letting the heat ease the deep ache spreading through his swollen hands.
thought: Resting might be my only work here.

action: Padding between Chills and Wesley, threading past ankles, sometimes curling close to Wesley's side as if to anchor him to the quiet afternoon.
thought: Wesley hurts still. I stay close.

description: Wesley finally accepted his exhaustion and rested by the fire; Chills gathered dry wood while Mutu moved quietly between them, holding the space together.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Still can't use my hands.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So you rest. That's your work today.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Doesn't feel like work.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Because you haven't learned to sit yet.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Sit how?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Just like this. Present. Not moving.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And that's... survival?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Sometimes it's the whole thing.

action: Sits by the fire counting the dwindling wood pile, calculating how long it will sustain them if carefully rationed.
thought: Six days, maybe seven if we're careful.

action: Flexes his swollen hands against the warmth of the fire, testing whether anything has improved since morning.
thought: Still useless. Still completely useless.

action: Rests in the smoke-shade beside Wesley, eyes half-closed and alert, occasionally glancing toward the forest rim.
thought: The scared one's out there. Getting closer now.

action: Edges closer through the ferns at the camp's rim, drawn by Mutu's fearless presence and the ghost-scent of morning kill.
thought: Small one holds still. The tall ones bolt.

description: By the fire at midday, Chills counts the depleting wood while Wesley tests his swollen hands; from the forest edge, the black panther edges closer, drawn by Mutu's fearless calm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Still swollen. Can't grip anything.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're doing rest-work. It matters.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Doesn't help the wood shortage though.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Gathering tomorrow, first light. You can scout.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Scout for what? I don't know what's good.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're faster spotting. Trust your eyes.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My eyes can spot. Nothing else works.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's enough. Scout, point, I'll cut.

action: He fed the fire dry wood and began preparing the small bird Mutu brought, moving with the easy patience of evening routine.
thought: This holds. Feed the fire, eat what comes.

action: He sat across from Chills at the fire, watching the meat cook and glancing toward the dark forest edge where something moved.
thought: The dark. Always something watching.

action: After delivering the kill, the ginger tabby settled near Chills' feet, tail curled, eyes following the panther's distant shadow at the forest line.
thought: The scared one. Still hungry. Still alone.

action: The young leopard hung back in the fern hollow, thin ribs visible even in the dimming light, drawn by the smell of roasting meat and held by the sight of the unbothered cat.
thought: Warm thing. Small fierce one. Safe.

description: By the fire's glow, Mutu's small kill roasts while Wesley watches the panther in the ferns and voices his hunger; Chills speaks his steady faith that tomorrow will provide.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: There's something out there. Watching from the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The young leopard. He's learning we're not the threat.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Great. Now we starve and feed cats with nothing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Mutu hunts. We eat. The river gives tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How are you sure about tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I'm not. But anger won't catch anything. Work does.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Right. Work.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You ate today. You'll eat tonight. That's the win.

action: Feeds dry wood to the fire slowly, watching the panther edge from the ferns with steady curiosity, unafraid.
thought: The dark brings out what the light conceals.

action: Sits by the fire fighting his eyelids, exhaustion finally winning as the panther crept closer to Mutu's quiet form.
thought: Can't keep my eyes open much longer now.

action: Lies by the fire unbothered as the panther edges closer, calm enough that the wild thing's hunger starts to soften.
thought: Fearless one draws close. No threat here.

action: Creeps from the ferns in the darkness, drawn by Mutu's fearless presence, hunger and loneliness finally outweighing the terror of the men.
thought: Warm place. Small fierce one. Safe distance.

description: The panther finally edges into the firelight, drawn to Mutu's fearless calm, while Wesley's exhaustion overwhelms his terror and Chills holds the line.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It's right at the edge now. Much closer than last night.

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Eyes catch firelight. Hunger outweighs fear. One careful step closer.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Chills. It's watching Mutu.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Mutu's not prey. Mutu doesn't flinch.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: If it attacks—

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Small fierce one holds still. Calm like the fire. Draw closer.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We should be ready to—I don't know. Something.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Fear invites attack. Calm holds the line.

action: Tends the fire at dawn, feeding dry branches while measuring the wood pile's dwindling height.
thought: Fire holds. Wesley's learning. We have time.

action: Wakes stiff and careful, moving to the fire with swollen hands that won't quite flex.
thought: Another day. At least I can breathe.

action: Pads through the camp perimeter with tail high, drawn toward the forest edge by something watching.
thought: Not afraid. The dark one follows.

action: Edges closer from the ferns, pulled by Mutu's fearless movement, then bolts back into shadow at Wesley's glance.
thought: Small fierce one. Safe. Others... no.

description: Wesley wakes stiff as Chills tends the fire at dawn; beyond the camp, Mutu's fearlessness draws the watching panther closer still.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My hands still won't flex properly.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Swelling means healing. Rest's the work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We burning through the wood okay?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Steady. We're good for days if we're smart.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That thing came to the fire again last night.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Mutu wasn't afraid. That's all the safety we need.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I still don't feel safe around it.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Eat, rest, don't watch the shadows. That's enough.

action: He shoulders his fishing line and heads down-trail toward the river shallows, moving steady and unbothered.
thought: I can take this. He needs the rest.

action: He slumps against the Cayenne's side, watching Chills disappear into the green, his legs too heavy to follow.
thought: I should be helping. But I can't move.

action: He slips into the ferns where the underbrush grows thick, ears sharp for the smallest movement.
thought: Warm smell, small thing. Hunt now.

action: It edges closer from the forest fringe, drawn by Mutu's movements, a shadow among shadows.
thought: Small fierce one. Watching from here.

description: Wesley's legs have given out; Chills shoulders the fishing line for the shallows while Wesley keeps the fire, and Mutu slips into the ferns hunting with the panther watching.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I can't... I need to help. But I can't feel my legs.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then don't. I'll fish the shallows. You stay here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's not fair to you.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Fair isn't the equation. Survival is.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I've become a burden.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You've become someone who rests when he needs to. That's not burden. That's learning.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Keep the fire alive. That's your job today.

action: He returns from the shallows with a few finger-length fish, setting them by the fire just as Wesley's face goes pale.
thought: Just a cub. More scared than he is.

action: He sits rigid by the fire, suddenly seeing the panther at the forest edge, and his breath catches in his throat.
thought: That's a predator. We have nowhere to run.

action: He slinks back from the forest with a rat in his teeth and settles by the fire to eat, unbothered by the watching panther.
thought: Small prey. Warm place. All is well.

action: It watches from the forest edge, ears back at the larger shapes, but eyes fixed on the small warm one eating by the fire.
thought: Small fierce one. Others still no. Not yet.

description: As afternoon heat settles, Wesley spots the panther watching from the forest edge and spirals; Chills steadies him toward a calmer truth.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: There's something at the tree line. Is that—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Just watching. Don't move.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's a leopard. That's a predator right there.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. But it's more scared of you than you are of it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It keeps staring at Mutu. How are you not panicking?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Because Mutu's not afraid. That's what matters.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I don't understand this jungle at all.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Not yet. But you're learning.

action: Returns from the shallows with four shiners, cooks them by the fire, and portions them out as evening settles.
thought: He's coming around to the rhythm now.

action: Keeps the fire hot all afternoon and evening, then eats the shiners by firelight while watching the forest edge.
thought: I kept the fire hot. That's something.

action: Sleeps curled near the fire, unbothered by the panther's presence at the fern's edge, tail flicking occasionally.
thought: Fire warm, his heartbeat steady, all is well.

action: Edges closer to the firelight than before, eyes fixed on Mutu's still form, wary but inexplicably drawn.
thought: The small fearless one does not run. Why?

description: By the fire's warmth, Chills portions the day's catch while Wesley keeps the flames hot; the panther's eyes glow at the fern's edge, inching closer to where Mutu sleeps unbothered.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: He's getting closer every night.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: He's drawn to Mutu. That's why.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That doesn't make him less of a threat.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. But it makes him predictable.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: A predator is a predator.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So am I. So's hunger. We live with them.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I can't run if he attacks.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You won't have to. Eat your fish.

action: Chills tends the fire as darkness deepens, catching the panther's amber eyes in the ferns, inching closer to where Mutu sleeps unbothered.
thought: He's scared. Mutu trusts him. That matters.

action: Wesley stiffens as movement flickers in the ferns, and the realization hits—those glowing eyes belong to the panther, far too close now.
thought: It's here. Too close. I can't breathe.

action: Mutu sleeps curled in the fire's warmth, her breathing steady and slow, utterly indifferent to the eyes tracking her from the jungle darkness.
thought: Fire warm. All is still and good.

action: The young panther moves one slow paw forward from the fern line, then freezes, torn between hunger and an older fear as the humans remain stone-still.
thought: She sleeps fearless. I cannot stay away now.

description: Night deepens and the panther's eyes glow in the ferns creeping closer to Mutu's sleeping form; Wesley spots it and his breath catches in terror, but Chills' steady presence at the fire becomes his anchor.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Chills. Eyes. There, in the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I see him. Young panther. Scared like we are.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Scared? It's a predator a few meters from us.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It is. And so is everything here. Watch Mutu.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: She's... sleeping. Right there.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: She trusts it more than we do. That means something.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What do we do?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We don't move. We let him choose.

action: He limps from the lean-to to the fire, fever-aching, and confronts the empty food stores.
thought: Food gone. We fish or starve.

action: He wakes in the Cayenne and drags himself out to the fire, leg throbbing with each movement.
thought: I can't even move without pain.

action: She stretches in the Cayenne's warmth, then slips out and prowls toward the ferns, hunting.
thought: The fear-one is far. I hunt.

action: The young panther emerges at the fern's edge as daylight strengthens, watching the camp from a wary distance.
thought: The fearless one hunts alone now.

description: Food stores are empty and the day is now — Chills and Wesley stand at the fire and decide to fish, fever and injury be damned.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Food's completely gone.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we fish. You able to help?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: My leg's still bad.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You don't wade. You hold the net. That's the work.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Just... standing there?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Watching the water, steadying the line. Your mind does it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Mutu's not scared of it at all.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: She knows what matters. We could learn that from her.

action: Wades into the shallows despite his fever burning through him, moving with practiced rhythm to find fish in the deep pools.
thought: Fever burns but hunger burns louder.

action: Limps into the river beside Chills despite shooting pain in his leg, pushing through discomfort to spot fish and position himself to help.
thought: Pain is here but so is he.

action: Settles on a smooth river rock, watching the men fish with feline indifference while his green eyes track movement in the water.
thought: These fearless ones hunt poorly. I wait.

action: Crouches low in the fern margin at the forest's edge, watching Mutu on the rocks with singular focus while the two men move in the water below.
thought: The fearless one is there. Cannot leave.

description: At the river shallows, Chills and Wesley wade into water burning with fever and pain to fish; Mutu settles on a rock while the panther watches from the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Your fever's gotten worse. You shouldn't be in the water.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Hungry is worse than fever. We fish today.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: This could drop you completely.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we'll handle it. Watch that pool—something moved there.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Movement at your one o'clock. Something large underneath.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Stay on it. You've got the eyes for this.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Ferns shifted at the tree line.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The panther. It's been there since dawn.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How can you be calm about that watching us?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Mutu isn't afraid of it. That tells me everything I need.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The cat logic thing again?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The cat knows what matters. So I trust the cat.

action: He wades in the warm shallows despite fever, guiding Wesley's casts as the afternoon light slants across the water.
thought: He's learning. That matters more than fish.

action: He lands three small fish with steady hands despite pain, hunger overriding the fear of the panther watching from the ferns.
thought: Hunger and his calm voice. Hunger wins.

action: She settles on a river rock, ears alert and body relaxed, watching the humans with absolute calm while the panther mirrors her from the ferns.
thought: Two humans learn. One stays calm.

action: She lies in the ferns watching Mutu on the rocks, eyes never leaving the calm cat while the men fish the shallows.
thought: Orange rests. Men work. I watch and wait.

description: Late afternoon at the river shallows: Chills and Wesley pull the last small fish from the warm water, while Mutu rests calm on a rock and the panther's eyes glow faintly in the ferns.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Chills... the black one's back.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Mutu's not worried. Neither should we be.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's easy for Mutu. He's not prey.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You landed three. That's your proof right here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Three isn't nine.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Three keeps us another day.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: When did you get so sure of everything?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: About an hour ago. I'm just hiding it well.

action: He ate slowly at the fire, fever burning through his body, shoulders heavy with the day's effort.
thought: Fever burns but the work holds.

action: He sat at the fire's edge with the small fish warming his hands, too tired to think past the next breath.
thought: I held on. That has to count.

action: She lay on the warm stones near the fire, utterly at ease, her green eyes calm as she watched the dark forest margin.
thought: They hold on. The dark knows I'm here.

action: The young panther crept from the ferns' edge, drawn by the golden cat's presence, its hunger and fear easier to carry when she was near.
thought: The orange one doesn't flee. Why stay?

description: At the fire after hours of fishing in fever and pain, Chills and Wesley eat the day's small catch in near-silence while Mutu rests calm nearby and the panther watches her from the ferns, closer than any previous night.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'm not sure I can do that again.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You did it today. That's the only day that counts.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Today I could barely feel my legs.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Today I couldn't feel anything but fire. Still here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah. Still here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Is the panther always this close at night?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: She brings him calm. The rest we leave alone.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Rest now. Tomorrow's its own day.

action: After hours of fishing in burning fever, Chills settles at the fire and feeds dry wood into the flames, his movements careful and measured.
thought: Fever burns but the work holds.

action: Wesley limps back to the fire and sinks onto a log, every muscle burning with exhaustion after a day spent wading and working through pain.
thought: I held on. That has to count.

action: Mutu settles on a rock near the fire, utterly calm and unbothered, her green eyes tracking the panther in the ferns.
thought: The dark one circles still.

action: The young panther edges closer to the camp's edge than any previous night, watching Mutu's stillness from the ferns, drawn and wary.
thought: The orange one doesn't flee.

description: Night has found them exhausted at the fire after hours of fishing in fever and pain; the panther watches from the ferns, closer than any previous night, drawn to Mutu's stillness.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's the panther. Right there at the edge.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. He's been trailing us since the river.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We should drive it off. Too close now.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. He's just watching. Mutu calms him.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: This isn't about Mutu. It's a predator.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So are we. And Mutu trusts him, it seems.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Trust doesn't mean he won't kill us.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: True. But it means he hasn't yet.

action: Wakes in the lean-to to find the fireframe destroyed and immediately begins salvaging usable wood, fever burning through him but his mind set on rebuilding.
thought: Fire's gone. We rebuild it all.

action: Emerges from the Cayenne into grey dawn to see Chills already moving in the wreckage, and exhaustion transforms into focus.
thought: He's fevering and working. I have to follow.

action: Rests on a sun-warmed rock between the Cayenne and the collapsed fire, watching both men work with the steady patience of something that has seen worse.
thought: They move as one now. Good.

action: Slinks closer from the bamboo stand toward the fern hollow, drawn by Mutu's unafraid stillness and the men's urgent work, edging nearer than daylight usually permits.
thought: Orange one rests still. I move closer.

description: The fireframe lies collapsed in grey dawn; Chills works it despite his fever while Wesley gathers wood, and for the first time they move as one without hesitation.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The storm... it took the fire down.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. Happened fast. But I salvaged some dry wood.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How are you even standing?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Not thinking about it. Here — drink some of this.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I don't feel thirsty.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Drink it anyway. We rebuild after.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay. I'll come with you.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's what I need.

action: He wades knee-deep at the river's edge, spear held low, moving with careful deliberation; his right shoulder throbs from yesterday's fever, but his focus is steady on the water.
thought: Pain doesn't stop the work. Just changes how.

action: He crouches on the rocks upstream, eyes sharp on the shallows, calling out depth and current; for the first time, he's guiding instead of following, and it steadies him.
thought: He's listening to me. This is real.

action: The cat dozes at the fire's edge, one ear cocked toward the forest; he's calm but watchful, sensing something drawing closer through the heat.
thought: The dark one moves near. Still learning.

action: It lingers at the bamboo stand's edge, belly low in the long grass, yellow eyes tracking Mutu across the camp; for the first time it ventures close in daylight, drawn by something it doesn't understand.
thought: Orange one near. I come closer too.

description: At the river's midday shallows, Chills wades behind Wesley, moving carefully; Wesley reads the water and calls directions, and for the first time Chills simply trusts him—no negotiation, just need.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're taking smaller steps.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Shoulder's still sore. Your eyes are better upstream.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I can handle the deeper water if—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. Stay where you are. Tell me what you see.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: There's a school moving under those rocks. Left side.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. I'm moving there now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're actually trusting my read.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You've been right every time. Why wouldn't I?

action: Sits at the fire's edge, feeding it bark and small wood with a tremor in his hands, trying not to show how the morning's fever-work has hollowed him.
thought: The fever breaks. But I'm empty now.

action: Settles next to Chills at the fire with the water jug, watches him shake for a moment, then stands to prepare for the afternoon's fishing run.
thought: He's completely exhausted. So someone needs to push here.

action: Presses into Chills' side at the fire, purring, eyes half-closed and ears pricked toward the forest beyond the clearing.
thought: His weakness reaches me. The dark one watches outside.

action: Lies in the bamboo fringe, watching Mutu's stillness by the fire, close enough now to see the cat's breathing and smell the warmth of the coals.
thought: The orange one sits quiet. I sit quiet. We are the same.

description: As afternoon heat settles, Wesley returns from the Cayenne to find Chills barely holding the fire—and sits to tell him a truth: the fishing is on Wesley now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're shaking. We need to eat.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know. I'll come help fish—

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: No. You rest.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Less than you are hurt. You taught me the water.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It's not the same twice—

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Then I'll read it again. Stay here.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Alright.

action: Sits by the fire as evening cools, fever-broken but hollow, watching Wesley and the panther with the last threads of his attention.
thought: He's steadier now. That counts.

action: Moves toward the fire's edge as darkness settles, speaking to the panther that circles Mutu with less fear each night.
thought: He's not running. Neither are we.

action: Settles by Chills' side at the fire, unbothered by the panther's approach, a still point between the wild and the camp.
thought: The dark one is learning calm.

action: Edges closer to Mutu at the fire's margin, ears forward, watching Wesley without the full tension of before, drawn by the orange cat's stillness.
thought: Orange one is safe. Still learning.

description: Wesley speaks to the panther for the first time as Chills sits fever-broken by the fire; the panther inches closer to Mutu, no longer hiding.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're always here when Mutu settles down.

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Steps beside the cat, ears forward, watching Wesley without fear.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Why don't you run? You've learned we won't hurt you.

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Presses against Mutu, a rumble that sounds almost like answer.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You understand something we don't. Mutu knows.

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Turns fully toward Wesley, no longer skulking at the camp's edge.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Then maybe we're learning the same thing. How to stay.

dialogue.speaker: panther
dialogue.line: Settles beside Mutu, close enough now to almost touch the fire.

action: Sits by the fire with the hollow exhaustion of fever-break, watching Wesley return with a quiet respect that goes unspoken.
thought: He carried it alone. We might survive this.

action: Returns from checking the firewood and settles opposite Chills, carrying the weight of the day's solo work in every careful movement.
thought: I did it. He sees it. That matters.

action: Curls between them by the fire, purring softly, offering the small steadiness of presence to Chills' emptied state.
thought: He needs quiet now. I am here.

action: Edges closer from the bamboo stand, drawn to Mutu's calm, watching the firelit camp from the forest dark.
thought: Orange one is still. I am calmer.

description: By nightfall, Wesley joins Chills at the fire; exhausted and emptied by fever, they sit in a quiet recognition of who carried what today, while Mutu settles between them and the panther watches from the bamboo edge, inching closer to Mutu's calm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You should eat more than me tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Won't happen. You're the one working.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You walked through fever like it wasn't there.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I stopped fighting it. Took the path of least resistance.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'm learning that from you.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It's only six days in, Wesley.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I know. But I see it.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we're alright, then. We'll make it.

action: He rests against the lean-to's edge, shoulder wrapped and fever still burning, watching Wesley move into the forest with a complicated gratitude.
thought: He's stronger than I thought.

action: He moves into the forest's edge with urgent purpose, gathering fallen branches and scanning the undergrowth — working the single day they've been granted as if it might vanish.
thought: One day. I can push that hard.

action: He settles near Chills at the lean-to, purring quietly in the morning heat — offering the stillness that the fever-sick man cannot find on his own.
thought: He needs my calm now.

action: From the bamboo stand's edge, the panther watches the camp separate — the tension between the men sending it further back even as Mutu's presence draws it forward.
thought: Stillness is safer than their noise.

description: At dawn, the fire burned to embers and the wood pile lay bare — Wesley finds Chills fever-broken at the lean-to and speaks what both have known since nightfall: they must move.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The fire's almost gone. We have no food left.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The river's lower now. We could cross today.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Look at me. I can barely lift my arm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So we wait here until what? Until we're too weak to move?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We wait one day. We gather, we rest, then we move with a chance.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: One day. That's all we can spare.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's how we survive this.

action: He moves through camp with new purpose, checking the fire and assessing their gear, already planning what to carry and what to abandon.
thought: It's time. We're ready to move.

action: He sits by the fire's right side, watching Chills move about, his mind running through distances and the weight of his own hollow frame.
thought: He means it. I have to trust him.

action: The ginger cat settles beside Wesley, pressing warm against his leg, indifferent to the men's planning.
thought: He's scared but he'll keep going.

action: From the bamboo edge, the young leopard watches the camp's activity, drawn by Mutu's stillness, unnerved by the men's restless energy.
thought: Orange one is calm. Others bring fear.

description: By midday, with the fire dwindling and their bellies empty, Chills pushes to leave at dawn — and Wesley, running on fumes, accepts.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: If we leave at dawn, we're really committing to this?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yes. Distance and the river. Both.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We have no food. And you were fever-broken yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Fever's gone. Jungle feeds those who know where to look.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I barely slept, Chills. I'm not sure I can push hard for kilometers.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You pushed yesterday. And you did it alone.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That was different.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. It's exactly what happens next. But longer.

action: He moves through camp checking rope and supplies, steady despite lingering weakness from the fever.
thought: Fever's broken. We move as planned.

action: He stacks their few possessions at the fire, hands moving quickly, restlessly—packing and repacking the same things.
thought: I can't do this again. I can't.

action: The cat moves between them at the camp, alert to the tension, not settling at the fire as usual.
thought: Something is changing in them today.

action: From the bamboo stand at the forest's edge, the panther watches Mutu move between the men, inching closer to the cat.
thought: The orange one is calm. I am calm.

description: As they pack at the camp, Wesley's fear pushes him to flee tonight, but Chills won't yield on dawn—and the panther watches Mutu, drawn to steady in the chaos.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We should leave now. Tonight.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: It's afternoon. We go at first light.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Why wait? You're better. We're ready.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We prepare tonight, we move at dawn. That's solid.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Every hour here, something could go wrong.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: And every hour on the move does too. Better rested.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Rested? Neither of us is resting.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we start at first light instead of the dark. Decision's made.

action: Chills sits at the fire's edge, cradling warm water, fever-light but steady, watching Wesley across the flames.
thought: Tomorrow we move. We can do this.

action: Wesley sits across the fire, knees pulled up, eyes on Chills, watching him like a tether.
thought: He's steady. I need to match that.

action: Mutu paces the camp's edge, tail high, occasionally slinking close to Chills before veering off again.
thought: Something's changing. Chills is moving.

action: The panther watches from the bamboo's shadow, eyes on Mutu, still and low.
thought: The orange one is safe. Others bring fear.

description: As evening settles, Chills and Wesley sit by the fire—both fevered and starving—finalizing their dawn departure. Mutu paces restlessly nearby; the panther watches from the bamboo's edge, drawn as always to the cat's stillness.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Tomorrow morning, you're really...?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: At first light. Water's good for the walk, the river clears south.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I know. I just—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're stronger than you think.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're still sick.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So are you. That's why we move now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What if I can't?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You'll carry it because I'm carrying mine.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Okay. Okay.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We move at dawn.

action: He tends the fire through the darkness, adding wood with methodical precision, exhausted but focused on keeping the flames alive for warmth and water-boiling come morning.
thought: Fear's real. So is the dawn.

action: He sits near the fire, initially trying to return to the Cayenne but lingering to talk with Chills about the panther, unable to shake his fear even as darkness deepens.
thought: Fear fades when he's steady like that.

action: Mutu lies on the Cayenne hood, warm and still, his stillness drawing the panther closer with each passing hour, unbothered by the humans' tension.
thought: The dark one brings peace here.

action: The panther edges from the bamboo toward the Cayenne hood, overcoming its terror of the two men for the sake of Mutu's stillness, moving in small brave increments through the firelit darkness.
thought: I am brave for the orange one.

description: As night deepens, the panther edges toward Mutu on the hood; Wesley sees it and freezes in terror, while Chills keeps his voice low and steady.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Chills. Do you see it?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Aren't you afraid?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Terrified. But it won't matter.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We move at dawn. That's the plan.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What if it attacks?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Then we deal with it. For now, we sleep.

action: Wakes to aching joints and heat behind his eyes, lies still on the shelter mat taking inventory of his body, then emerges pale and unsteady.
thought: Every part of me is burning.

action: Rolls out of the Cayenne at first light and strides toward the pack, already mentally running through supplies for the dawn move, then stops as his head swims.
thought: Fever's bad. We need to go now.

action: Drops a small dead mouse by the cold fire pit, then paces between the shelter and the Cayenne, ears alert and restless.
thought: The orange one is closer today.

action: Edges from the bamboo at first light, watching Mutu drop the kill; half-hidden in the fern hollow, still terrified but pulled closer by the cat's stillness.
thought: For the orange one I am brave.

description: Wesley strides toward the Cayenne to pack for the dawn move while Chills emerges from the lean-to shaking and pale—the plan is unraveling before they even begin.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We move in an hour. You said dawn.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I'm not moving today, Wes.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What? You said that last night.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know. My body won't let me listen.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So we just sit here? We're running out of time.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: One more day won't kill us. Moving will.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You don't know that.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I do. And if you're honest, so do you.

action: Stumbles out of the lean-to shaking, grips the Cayenne to steady himself, then retreats back inside to collapse onto the palm fronds.
thought: Can't move like this. Not today.

action: Stands firm by the fire pit through the argument, then gathers deadwood from the forest's edge once Chills retreats, hands steady for the first time in days.
thought: He finally admitted it. We stay.

action: Prowls the space between Cayenne and fern_hollow all through midday, ears alert, green eyes tracking faint movement in the undergrowth.
thought: The dark one edges ever closer.

action: Edges steadily closer through the ferny margins at the camp's edge, ribs trembling with hunger and longing, eyes never leaving Mutu's orange stillness.
thought: The orange one draws me near.

description: By midday Chills emerges from the lean-to fevered and pale; Wesley confronts him at the Cayenne door, and they settle the question of moving — the fever has broken the plan, and for the first time, Chills admits he cannot walk.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: We don't move today. Your fever's worse.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I'm fine. Just need water and rest.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're not fine. And we have no food, no medicine. We need to stay.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Staying means going hungry. You know this.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Moving means you collapse on the trail. I'd rather stay.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Figure what out? There's nothing left to eat.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Then we hunt, trap, forage — today we heal. Tomorrow we move.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're right. Just... hard to admit it.

action: He emerged from the lean-to in the afternoon, feverish and weak, and moved slowly to the fire's edge to sit with Wesley.
thought: Every part of me burns still.

action: He kept the fire alive through the afternoon, boiled water for Chills, and gathered what wood he could find before sitting down at the fire's edge.
thought: He needs me to be strong.

action: Mutu paced restlessly around the camp, circling back to Chills, then drawn repeatedly toward the forest edge where shadow moved behind the ferns.
thought: Dark one pulls closer each sun.

action: The young leopard edged from the fern hollow toward the forest margin, watching Mutu with bold, terrified eyes, keeping just beyond the firelight.
thought: For the orange one, I am brave.

description: At the fire's edge, Chills and Wesley settled into quiet work — boiling water, tending coals — while a black shape watched from the forest, edging steadily closer to Mutu.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You look like hell. How's the fever?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Peaks and valleys. I'm managing.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You're not managing if you can barely stand.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Wesley, I know what—

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Look, I've got the water and the fire. The wood can wait. You rest.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The wood's running low. You should—

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I know. I saw it. One thing at a time, yeah?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. Okay.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: And you drink that water.

action: Sits by the fire, shaking slightly despite the heat, watching Wesley work.
thought: My body's betraying me out here.

action: Pushes a piece of wood deeper into the coals, the firelight hard on his face.
thought: He can't walk. It's on me now.

action: Rests by the fire's warmth, watching the forest edge with an unusual calm.
thought: The dark one is near. Safe.

action: Crouches at the fern hollow's edge, ears flattened but still drawn toward Mutu's calm rest.
thought: The orange one gives me courage.

description: Evening by the fire: Wesley tended the coals all day while Chills sat fevered and immobile; by dusk the panther was close enough for Mutu to sense it at the forest edge.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You need to eat something.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Not hungry. Just thirsty.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You need the calories. You're burning through nothing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know. Tomorrow. Right now... just need to not move.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Wood's low. We forage at first light.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: If I can walk.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Right. If.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Wesley. Thank you. For today.

action: Rests by the fire, the fever finally easing, body still aching but clearer than this morning.
thought: Fever's breaking. Wesley held the whole line.

action: Sits across from Chills by the coals, jaw tight with exhaustion but steady, the fire held through the long day.
thought: I didn't break. I actually carried it.

action: Alert in the camp's edge, ears tracking the dark shape at the forest boundary, unfraid and oddly calm.
thought: The dark one is close. Safe.

action: Edges incrementally closer from the fern hollow, drawn by Mutu's stillness, ribs showing in the moonlight as it settles low in the undergrowth.
thought: The orange one is still. I am safe.

description: By the fire at night, Chills' fever finally breaking, Wesley and he sit in exhausted relief — the first real quiet between them, while Mutu senses the panther at the forest edge.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How's the fever?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Breaking. Still feel like hell though.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You rest. I've got the fire.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Doesn't matter right now.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You did good today.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Just did what needed doing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. You led when I couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Panther's getting bolder.

action: Wakes by the fire with the fever finally broken, weak but clear-headed, and lets Wesley hand him water and foraged fruit.
thought: I'm still here. My body came back.

action: Hands Chills a cup of boiled water and settles across the fire, visibly hollowed but steady after keeping the camp running alone.
thought: He's going to recover. I held the line.

action: Stretches in the morning sun near the fire, then slinks toward the forest edge where the panther watches from the ferns.
thought: The dark one is close. I feel safe.

action: Watches Mutu from deep in the ferns, edging slightly closer as the men move slowly and speak low by the fire.
thought: The orange one is still. I watch.

description: Chills wakes fever-broken and weak; Wesley sits across the fire, handing over boiled water and fruit after keeping the camp running alone all night.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Fever broke. You're actually awake.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: How long was I out?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: All yesterday. I had the fire, water, shelter.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You did that alone?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You were burning up. Someone had to.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We're not moving today. I need rest.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah. You need it.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Stop looking shocked you can do this.

action: Sits by the fire, fever finally broken, watching Wesley prepare the line and hooks.
thought: He's got it now. I just need rest.

action: Gathers line and hook, preparing to fish downstream where the current runs faster.
thought: I know what I'm doing. Keep moving.

action: Prowls the forest edge near the fern hollow, ears alert to a familiar scent on the breeze.
thought: The dark one is close. I'm not alone.

action: Watches from the fern hollow, eyes fixed on Mutu's movement, drawn closer but still afraid of the camp.
thought: The orange one waits. I can wait too.

description: Chills, fever-broken, watches Wesley prepare to fish while the camp hungers for food.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'm heading to the rocks.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're running on fumes.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: So are you. But someone has to move.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Don't burn yourself out.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I won't. Just doing what needs doing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Okay. Be back before dark, yeah?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I will. I've got this.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know you do.

action: Rests by the fire, watching Wesley return from the river with the day's first real catch.
thought: He's stronger than he knows. I can rest.

action: Returns from the river with three fish, kneels to clean them while Chills watches from the fire.
thought: I actually caught them. I can do this.

action: Trails Wesley back from the river, settles by the fire where Chills sits, ears pricked toward the forest edge.
thought: He brings food. The hidden one is close.

action: Watches from the fern hollow at the forest's edge, eyes fixed on Mutu by the fire, too afraid of the men to move closer.
thought: The orange one is still. Safe. I wait.

description: Wesley cleans three fish by the fire as Chills rests without worry; from the forest edge, a young panther watches only Mutu, drawn by the cat's unshakeable calm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I caught three. Finally got it right.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah? How'd you manage it?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Just... stopped overthinking. Stood still and waited.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That's the whole thing, isn't it.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You should eat first. You've lost weight.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We eat together.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Always?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Always.

action: He settles back against the fire-side stones, hands wrapped around a bowl of boiled fish, fever-broken but too weak to move from the camp.
thought: I have to let him carry this.

action: He portions the last of the fish onto palm leaves with steady hands, placing a careful share before Chills, then settling across the fire with his own.
thought: I can actually keep us alive.

action: He curls into Chills' lap, purring low and unbothered, his green eyes tracking the dark forest beyond the firelight.
thought: He's resting. I keep him safe.

action: It edges a paw closer through the ferns, black as the night and barely visible, eyes fixed on the orange cat by the fire.
thought: The orange one is still. Not alone.

description: By the fire as night falls, Wesley portions the last boiled fish while Chills settles back to eat; from the ferns beyond, two yellow eyes watch the flames.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Eat, then sleep. I've got the rest.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I'm not used to being taken care of.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Yeah, well, get used to it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Fair enough. Is the cat always that calm?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Mutu doesn't get scared. That's his whole thing.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: So there's something in the dark we should know about.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You think it means us harm?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No. I think it means Mutu knows something we don't.

action: Settles into the lean-to shelter for the night, fever finally broken, body heavy with earned rest
thought: He's carrying it now. I can rest.

action: Tends the fire as full darkness falls, adding wood methodically, handling the night watch alone
thought: The night is mine to keep now.

action: Settles by the fire's edge with quiet certainty, unafraid of the eyes watching from the dark
thought: The hidden one waits close still.

action: Edges from the fern hollow to the forest margin, drawn by Mutu's steadiness, yellow eyes fixed on the fire's glow
thought: The orange one stays. I move closer now.

description: As Chills finally settles fully into the shelter, Wesley tends the fire alone into the deepening night; from the ferns beyond, two yellow eyes watch Mutu's unshakeable calm, drawing closer than ever before.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You need proper rest. I can handle the fire.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Already heading there, mate. You've got this now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It's weird to say—but I think I actually do.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: No thinking. You kept us alive today.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Just don't want to mess it up.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You won't. Fire's burning, water's ready, Mutu's calm.

action: Wakes in the lean-to with clear head for the first time in days, fever finally broken, and sees the fire still burning at the camp.
thought: He held it all night alone.

action: Sits by the rebuilt fire as dawn breaks, dark circles under his eyes, the flames still burning steady from hours of patient tending.
thought: I kept it alive all night long.

action: Stretched out on the Cayenne hood, watching the morning sun warm the mist rising from the clearing, unbothered and at ease.
thought: Sun is warm. All is still.

action: Pressed low in the ferns at the forest edge, watching Mutu on the hood with unblinking golden eyes, inching closer than before.
thought: The orange one waits. Safe and still.

description: At dawn by the burning fire, Chills emerged to find Wesley dead-eyed from keeping watch all night alone—and for the first time, stepped forward to receive the care he'd given.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You've been up all night.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Fire didn't go out. You needed sleep.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I should have been here.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: You were sick. I could do it.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Yeah. I see that now.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Come sit. There's water and fish.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You're dead on your feet.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: For the first time, it's okay.

action: He sat by the rebuilt fire with a cup of hot water, watching Wesley collapse onto the log across from him with the satisfaction of a man who'd done real work.
thought: He actually held it. All night.

action: He eased onto the log across from Chills, every muscle announcing itself; he'd boiled two pots of fish scraps into broth and soaked down the fire-wood pit against the afternoon heat.
thought: I'm so tired I could sleep standing.

action: The ginger cat stretched across the Cayenne hood in the noon sun, utterly content; one ear twitched toward the forest edge where two yellow eyes had begun to surface between the fern fronds.
thought: The hidden one watches. Still afraid.

action: It lay in the dense fern hollow, close enough now to catch Mutu's scent on the wind; in full daylight it felt exposed, but the cat's stillness was hypnotic, and it inched forward into the shadow of the bamboo fringe.
thought: The orange one is still. No fear.

description: At the midday fire, Chills rests easy while Wesley collapses on the log across from him—the shift is quiet and real. Mutu dozes on the Cayenne hood; from the ferns, two yellow eyes track the cat's stillness.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You actually slept?

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: No. But the fire didn't die, so that's winning.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: You held the whole camp alone, Wesley. That matters.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Only because you rested. We both needed to stop falling apart.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: I know. And I notice.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: The wood pit is soaked. Fire's stable until the rain.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Good. Today you rest. That's an order.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'll sleep better knowing you're actually watching.

action: He tends the fire with steady hands, feeding dry wood into the embers while keeping watch on the camp's edges.
thought: The cat knows something I don't. Yet.

action: He sits across from Chills, exhaustion finally catching up to him, eyes tracking the ferns beyond the firelight.
thought: That shape. That moving shape. Is it...

action: The cat lies unmoving on the Cayenne hood, ears relaxed, watching the ferns with absolute calm.
thought: It comes. Safe. Still.

action: The young leopard emerges from the ferns into the clearing's edge, body low but moving steadily toward Mutu's stillness.
thought: The orange one waits. I am not afraid.

description: By the fire, Chills tends the embers as a black shape emerges from the ferns—the panther, drawn to Mutu at last, and Wesley's breath catches while Chills stays calm.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: Chills. There. In the ferns—is that—

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Panther. Young one. Been coming back for days.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That's a PREDATOR. We should do something.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Sit still. Don't look at it directly.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How is that a plan?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: The cat isn't afraid. That tells me something.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It's getting closer. God, it's getting closer.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: To Mutu. Not to us.

action: Tends the fire with steady hands, watching the panther's slow approach with curiosity and respect, occasionally glancing at Wesley to gauge his fear.
thought: The jungle shows itself when you stop running.

action: Sits stiff on the log, breath shallow, eyes fixed on the dark shape at the clearing's edge, hands gripping the edge of his seat.
thought: My hands won't stop shaking but I stay.

action: Dozes near the fire's edge, unbothered by the panther's presence at the clearing boundary, a living calm in the amber light.
thought: The dark one is less afraid each night.

action: Lingers at the forest's boundary, drawn closer by Mutu's stillness, golden eyes reflecting the firelight as it edges into the clearing's glow.
thought: The still orange one draws me toward light.

description: The panther emerged fully at dusk, a lean black shape drawn to Mutu's stillness; by the fire, Chills and Wesley sat close, Chills calm and Wesley breathing hard.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That was a panther. A black panther. It was watching us.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: A young one. Drawn to Mutu, not to us.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: How are you so unfazed? That's a predator.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: And Mutu's unfazed. That tells us something.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: What does it tell us?

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: That the jungle has its own rules. We're learning them.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: I'm not learning anything except terror.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Terror's just the first step.

action: Sits by the fire through the evening, tending the flames with calm patience, watching the forest edge while speaking with Wesley.
thought: The cat never fears. That matters.

action: Settles across the fire from Chills, adrenaline still high, speaking in clipped sentences about the panther and what it means.
thought: He's calm. I'm not. How is he so calm?

action: Rests by the fire, purring softly, occasionally glancing toward the forest where the panther watches.
thought: The dark one is close now. No fear.

action: Moves to the forest edge as night deepens, drawn by Mutu's warmth and stillness, watching the cat from just beyond the firelight.
thought: The orange one is safe. I can stay.

description: Sitting by the fire at night, Wesley struggles with fear while Chills speaks calm reason; Mutu rests utterly unbothered as a young panther watches from the ferns—drawn only to the cat.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: That thing was meters from the fire. A leopard.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: Came for the cat, not for us.

dialogue.speaker: wesley
dialogue.line: It's still dangerous. We should do something.

dialogue.speaker: chills
dialogue.line: We are doing something. Look at Mutu.
